text:
Capex – FY 27 capex guidance updated to INR 3,000 crores (previously INR 1,500 crores, now INR 2,000 crores) (Q1 FY 27).  
Capex – FY 28 capex guidance remains at INR 3,000 crores, with possibility of higher spend (Q1 FY 27).  
R&D spend – management reiterated that R&D spend will be 5.8 % of revenue for the year (Q1 FY 27).
